name: Sub Rosa: private RFQs
description: Private requests for quotes: binds an RFQ to a Sub Rosa ReceiptOnly sealed-proposal round on Stellar, records the client-verified result and links the payment intent that pays the selected provider. Settlement stays in Cosmos Pay.
author: Sub Rosa contributors (https://github.com/karagozemin/cosmospay-sub-rosa-plugin), reviewed by Cosmos Pay support
